author: Bellular News
description:
AI generated content used to be a shovelware problem. Now it's turning up in real, full-price AAA games, and Steam's disclosure labels are the reason we can prove it. The stranger part is that a lot of the developers behind it genuinely don't understand why players feel betrayed.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
